subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Decision Hygiene
description: A quick win: understand Decision Hygiene.

hook.text: Two judges see the same case, same facts. One gives 5 years, the other gives 12. This gap is noise.

buildup.text: Kahneman's 'Noise' shows that variability in human judgment is far larger than people realize.

discovery.text: Decision hygiene: structured processes that reduce noise without needing to identify the specific bias.

twist.text: You don't need to fix each bias individually. Standardizing the process reduces all biases at once.

climax.text: Checklists, rubrics, and independent assessments before discussion cut noise dramatically.

punchline.text: Fix the process, not the person.

quiz.question: What is the goal of decision hygiene?
options: Reduce variability and noise in decisions through structure
